question: In a certain code language, ‘RIVER’ is coded as ‘SJWFS’ and ‘SYSTEM’ is coded as ‘TZTUFN’. How is ‘PACK’ coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘RIVER’ is coded as ‘SJWFS’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd05c675373820509f462c5349552753d7432ae1a995b4ccd23d97a9502951b0.png] 

And,

‘SYSTEM’ is coded as ‘TZTUFN’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fbb67234e6f9c04291d23f7c9ede1c112d1d622cfea1dd3b505ea0322180fed.png] 

Similarly,

‘PACK’ is coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b47f8f1cd0332e703407400f3f2cce16e97843781dcc59b53ba1f27e94717769.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
